hard.q: Correct the mistake: If you will eat healthy food, you stay fit.
a: If you eat healthy food, you stay fit.

hard.q: Change to the first conditional: If I study hard, I pass the exam.
a: If I study hard, I will pass the exam.

hard.q: Change to the third conditional: If I have time, I visit my grandmother.
a: If I had had time, I would have visited my grandmother.

hard.q: Change to the first conditional: If he gets a pay rise, he buys a car.
a: If he gets a pay rise, he will buy a car.

hard.q: Make the result negative: If he forgets his keys, he stays outside.
a: If he forgets his keys, he does not stay outside.

hard.q: Change to the first conditional: If he knows the answer, he tells us.
a: If he knows the answer, he will tell us.

hard.q: Change to the first conditional: If you speak slowly, they understand you.
a: If you speak slowly, they will understand you.

hard.q: Correct the mistake: If you will touch the fire, you get burnt.
a: If you touch the fire, you get burnt.

hard.q: Correct the mistake: If I had the money, I buy that jacket.
a: If I have the money, I buy that jacket.
